## MAI Image 2.7 Flash API

MAI Image 2.7 Flash is an image generation and image editing model by MAI, available on the Venice API as `mai-image-2-7-flash`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

MAI Image 2.7 Flash is the faster, lower-cost variant of Microsoft's MAI Image 2.7. It renders at 1K or 2K in seven aspect ratios and supports transparent backgrounds.

### MAI Image 2.7 Flash API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mai-image-2-7-flash` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.02 / image |
| `mai-image-2-7-flash-edit` | Edit | Anonymized | $0.02 / edit |

### MAI Image 2.7 Flash specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | MAI |
| Released | Nov 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Resolutions | 1K, 2K |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3 |
| Prompt limit | 32,000 characters |

### How to use the MAI Image 2.7 Flash API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "mai-image-2-7-flash"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "mai-image-2-7-flash",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
